daily_load_assessment: ATL is currently minimal at 6.6 with a TSB of +6.3, reflecting zero training load logged over the past 19 days. Freshness is maximum, but muscular and aerobic readiness require a structured re-entry after this extended gap.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Acute training status over the last 21 days has effectively collapsed, with only a single 7.8km run recorded on November 2nd (Load 42). Fitness (CTL) has dropped to 12.9. Immediate re-establishment of consistent weekly training frequency is mandatory to start rebuilding your acute adaptation rate safely.

Reaching your target CTL of 60 requires a disciplined, long-term ramp rate of +1 to +2 CTL per week, strictly anchored by the 70/30 pyramidal distribution.
coach_verdict: Execute Priority 1 (Aerobic Base Re-Entry Run + Cadence Strides) today. After a 19-day training hiatus, jumping straight into high-intensity quality intervals is an injury risk. Re-building your aerobic baseline is the highest ROI move right now.

priority_1.session_title: Aerobic Base Re-Entry Run + Cadence Strides
priority_1.workout_details: 10 min Warm-up easy jog -> 35 min Zone 2 steady run (HR strictly <152 bpm) -> 4 x 15-sec fast/relaxed strides (focusing on turn-over, full recovery between) -> 5 min Cool-down walk. Total: ~55 min.
priority_1.reason: Top recommendation. Safely reactivates your aerobic engine and neuromuscular running economy after 19 days of rest without causing excess muscle damage or acute injury.

priority_2.workout_details: 10 min Progressive warm-up -> 45 min steady Zone 2 endurance (85-95 rpm, target 160-175 W) -> 5 min Easy spin cool-down. Total: 60 min.
priority_2.reason: Low-impact alternative to build foundational TSS and support your cycling FTP goals while keeping mechanical strain on joints low.

priority_3.session_title: Posterior Chain Torque & Upper Body Strength
priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 min dynamic mobility -> Barbell Back Squats: 3 x 8 -> Barbell Romanian Deadlifts: 3 x 8 -> Overhead Press: 3 x 8 -> Sandbag Core Carry: 3 x 45 sec -> Pull-ups or Heavy Rows: 3 x 10. Total: ~45 min.
priority_3.reason: Establishes baseline musculoskeletal force production for cycling torque and running stance stability without conflicting with endurance recovery.
